Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game then! We hope you enjoyed the coverage. Do join in for the second T20I of the series between these sides on Wednesday (December 18th) at 00:00 GMT from the same venue. It will be a must-win for the Windies if they are to stay alive in this series. Until then, goodbye and take care!

Litton Das says he's surprised with how the wicket behaved as it was tough. Mentions 147 was a decent score and he backs his bowlers. Adds he expects his his team to play well and with passion. Ends by saying, he hopes to win this series.

Rovman Powell says they need to be a lot more careful at the start, they knew Bangladesh only had a chance if they took early wickets. Mentions he always tries to lead from the front and he's happy he's a lot more consistent. Adds the batting group let their side down but the bowlers were really good. Ends by saying they're a good T20 side but haven't been at their best in the recent past.

Mahedi Hasan, MAN OF THE MATCH, says he stuck to his basics and tried to get it right. Mentions he enjoyed bowling on this wicket and the global T20 League gave him good confidence. Ends by saying he looked to put up a partnership with Shamim Hossain.

Earlier in the day, Bangladesh struggled with the bat for most parts of their innings but a good cameo from Mahedi Hasan and an excellent knock from Shamim Hossain took them to a decent score which we still felt was under par. However, an excellent combined bowling effort has helped them get over the line.

Powell and Romario Shepherd stepped on the gas and they started striking it big! A few big overs and the game was right in the gasp of the Windies. It came down to the Windies needing just over a run-a-ball but the likes of Taskin, Tanzim and Hasan bowled three brilliant overs towards the end to record a remarkable victory.

Bangladesh were brilliant with the new ball. Das was exceptional with his changes. The pacers kept it tight and Mahedi Hasan ran through the top order in no time. West Indies looked dead and buried when they were 7 down and needed over 10 per over.

What a game of cricket! Brilliant! It kept swinging from one way to the another but in the end, it's the visitors who finally get a win on this tour in the white ball format. Credit to them to hold their nerve throughout. Credit to Hasan Mahmud to bowl a brilliant last over to help his side get over the line. Real character shown by their bowlers especially after how they were beaten in the ODI series.

Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Taskin Ahmed to Johnson Charles, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pooran is off the mark! Around off. Length. This is driven to mid off. A simple single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Taskin Ahmed to Nicholas Pooran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Excellent stuff! Length and around off. Shaping away. Pooran leaves it alone in the end.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Taskin Ahmed to Nicholas Pooran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Off the pad! On the pads. Pooran looks to pull. This goes off the thigh pad. It lands just short of square leg.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Taskin Ahmed to Nicholas Pooran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Length and outside off. Pooran needs a sighter and leaves it alone.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Taskin Ahmed to Nicholas Pooran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! Taken! Taskin strikes! Early blow for the Windies and that's the perfect start for the visitors. Lovely delivery. This starts around leg. Shapes away late. King looks to whip it against the movement. It goes off the leading edge between cover and mid off. The latter takes it with a dive. Very good catch. A short stay for King. Bangladesh have begun really well.

Commentary.Commentary: He does! That's a brilliant first over! A yorker to end as he sees Charles make room. This is jammed back to the bowler.

Commentary.Commentary: Good stuff! On middle. Shaping away. Charles is solid in defense. He needs to end the over well now.

Commentary.Commentary: King is off the mark! Length again and on off. This is driven wide of mid off for a run.

Commentary.Commentary: A wild swing there. This is short and outside off. Shaping away. King looks to go over mid-wicket but misses it.

Commentary.Commentary: And again, length and around off. King plays it on the up but straight to cover this time.

Commentary.Commentary: That's brilliant fielding but what timing! That pinged off the bat! Length and on off. King strikes it on the up. The fielder at cover dives to his right and stops it.
